headline: Twenty days out, and you are further ahead than your watch thinks.
body:
Weeks 1 and 2 are done: **eleven of twelve sessions**, all six gym days, and the one brick the plan asked for. Sunday's 16 km at 5:40/km on 144 bpm is the number to hold onto — that is 23 s/km faster than your treadmill anchor at five beats lower.

Today is a full rest day and it stays that way. HRV came in Unbalanced on Saturday and Sunday, which is the plan's own trigger to back off, and this is the one week where the Saturday session genuinely matters.

**This week the shape changes.** Swim moves to Tuesday so it sits with Legs, and the back day moves to Thursday — no more swimming on wrecked lats. Sea swim lands Sunday, on the weekend, where you wanted it.

One thing to sort before Saturday: get the ankle looked at. Everything else in here is adjustable; that is the only item that decides whether there is a race to adjust for.
